哦！你帶齊了製作1副蝗蟲眼鏡所需的材料！很好，很好！我會以馴獸師的驕傲，馬上為你製作！

scripts.text:
[YuU]
Okay, now all I gotta do is take this Zargon and, um, make glasses lenses out of them. Somehow.
scripts.translation:
[尤烏]
好了，現在只要拿剎勒空結晶...嗯...想辦法把它做成鏡片就行。

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Squeak squeak crush snap*^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF*吱吱 吱吱 咯吱 咔嚓*^000000

scripts.text:
[YuU]
Whew! Lucky!
Somehow I did it.
Please take this for
the cute monster you
are raising.
Rocker Glasses!
scripts.translation:
[尤烏]
呼！真走運！不知怎麼，我還是成功了。把它帶給你正在培養的可愛魔物吧。蝗蟲眼鏡！

scripts.text:
[YuU]
For the monster owner that likes monster glasses, we provide a way to make Rocker Glasses!
scripts.translation:
[尤烏]
如果你喜歡給魔物戴眼鏡，我們可以教你製作蝗蟲眼鏡！

scripts.text:
[YuU]
Just bring me...
^3355FF2 Zargon^000000
^3355FF1 Ribbon^000000 and
^3355FF400 zeny^000000. 
I will make it for you, with all my pride as a monster tamer!
scripts.translation:
[尤烏]
帶來^3355FF2個剎勒空結晶^000000、^3355FF1條絲帶^000000和^3355FF400 Zeny^000000，我就會以馴獸師的驕傲為你製作！

scripts.text:
[YuU]
Ah...!
You must have not decided which Monster you want to raise.
scripts.translation:
[尤烏]
啊...！
您一定還沒決定好要培養哪種魔物。

scripts.text:
[YuU]
Definitely not a decision to be made carelessly! Your pet monster will accompany you throughout your life. Please take your time and return when you have decided.
scripts.translation:
[尤烏]
這絕對不是一個可以草率決定的事情！您的寵物魔物將伴隨您一生。請慢慢考慮，決定好後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Are you pre-occupied with
gathering items for monsters
and want a break? 
We will gather items
for your Cute Pets.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
你正忙著為魔物收集道具，想歇一歇嗎？我們可以替你收集寵物所需的道具。

scripts.text: ^3355FF' Monster Taming '^000000?
Order ^3355FF' Book of Devil '^000000
Order ^3355FF' No Recipient '^000000
Order ^3355FF' Orc Trophy '^000000
Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
The monster taming items are necessary to communicate with the monster of your choice! We Monster Tamer guild members have a very reasonable offer...
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
馴獸道具是與你選定的魔物溝通所必需的！我們馴獸師公會為你準備了優惠價格...

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
We provide a system that allows you to get your hands on these cool items with less of the hassle!
Book of Devil!
No Recipient!
Orc Trophy!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
我們有辦法讓你輕鬆獲得這些好用的道具！惡魔之書、無人認領的信、獸人獎盃！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
For 1 Book of Devil, you can exchange:
^3355FF1 Old Magic Book^000000
^3355FF2 Horrendous Mouth^000000.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
1本惡魔之書可用^3355FF1本古魔法書^000000和^3355FF2個亡者之牙^000000兌換。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
For 1 No Recipient, you can exchange ^3355FF1 Old Portrait^000000.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
1幅破舊畫像可兌換^3355FF1封無人認領的信^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Lastly, you can exchange
^3355FF1 Chivalry Emblem^000000 and
^3355FF1 Scorpion Tail^000000
for 1 Orc Trophy.
Try these fantastic items!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
最後，你可以用^3355FF1枚騎士團之證^000000和^3355FF1條蠍子尾巴^000000兌換1個獸人獎盃。試試這些好東西吧！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
This is an item far beyond what humans can read! Its name? ^3355FFBook of Devil^000000! A very mysterious item that can supposedly summon demons...
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
這件道具遠超人類的理解！它的名字是？^3355FF惡魔之書^000000！據說這是一件能召喚惡魔的神秘道具...

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Oh! You have all the items necessary to make 1 Book of Devil! Good, good! With all my pride as a monster tamer, I will make one for you right away.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
哦！你帶齊了製作1本惡魔之書所需的材料！很好，很好！我會以馴獸師的驕傲，馬上為你製作一本。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Let's see...
Hmm, this is going to be hard.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
讓我看看...嗯，這有點難辦。

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Knock knock scrape scrape*^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF*咚咚 咚咚 刮擦 刮擦*^000000

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Okay. All done.
Please take it for
the cute monster you
are raising.
Book of Devil!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
好了，完成了。把它帶給你正在飼養的可愛魔物吧。惡魔之書！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
For the owner that wishes to raise a monster that can be summoned using the Book of Devil, we provide a way to create 1 Book of Devil!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
如果你想飼養能用惡魔之書召喚的魔物，我們可以教你製作1本惡魔之書！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Just bring me...
^3355FF1 Old Magicbook^000000 and
^3355FF2 Horrendous Mouth^000000!
If you bring me these items, with all my pride as a monster tamer, I will make it for you!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
帶來^3355FF1本古魔法書^000000和^3355FF2個亡者之牙^000000，我就會以馴獸師的驕傲為你製作！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
This is an item which expresses feelings beyond what a human can feel. Its name? ^3355FFNo Recipient^000000! Who sent this letter, and who was supposed to receive it?
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
這件道具承載著人類難以體會的情感。它的名字是？^3355FF無人認領的信^000000！這封信是誰寄出的，又是寄給誰的？

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Oh! You have all the items necessary to make No Recipient! Good, good! With all my pride as a monster tamer, I will make one for you right away.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
哦！你帶齊了製作無人認領的信所需的材料！很好，很好！我會以馴獸師的驕傲，馬上為你製作一封。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Got to fold this Old Portrait just right...
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
得把這幅舊肖像摺疊得恰到好處...

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Scrape scrape brush brush*^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF*刮擦 刮擦 刷刷 刷刷*^000000

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Okay. All done.
Please take this item
for the cute monster
you are raising.
No Recipient!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
好了，完成了。把這件道具帶給你正在飼養的可愛魔物吧。無人認領的信！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
For the monster owner that is fond of No Recipient, we provide a way to create to special item!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
如果你喜歡無人認領的信，我們可以教你製作這件特別道具！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Just bring me...
^3355FF1 Old Portrait^000000!
If you bring this to me, with all my pride as a monster tamer, I will make it for you!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
帶來^3355FF1幅舊肖像^000000，我就會以馴獸師的驕傲為你製作！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
This is an item far beyond the pride of humans!
Its name?
^3355FFOrc Trophy^000000!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
這件道具承載著人類難以企及的自豪。它的名字是？^3355FF獸人獎盃^000000！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Oh! You have all the items necessary to make an Orc Trophy! Good, good! With all my pride as a monster tamer, let me make one for you right away!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
哦！你帶齊了製作獸人獎盃所需的材料！很好，很好！我會以馴獸師的驕傲，馬上為你製作一個！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Got to...
Fit this Scorpion Tail...
Just right...
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
得...把這條蠍子尾巴裝好...要恰到好處...

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Clang clang Boong*^000000

[Shogo]
Okay. All done.
Please take this for
the cute monster
you are raising...
Orc Trophy!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
好了，完成了。把這個送給你正在飼養的可愛魔物吧...獸人獎盃！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
For the monster owner
who is fond of Horror of Tribe...
One way to make Horror of Tribe !
^3355FF 1 Chivalry Emblem^000000!
^3355FF 1 Scorpion Tail^000000!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
喜歡獸人獎盃的魔物主人，可以用^3355FF1枚騎士團之證^000000和^3355FF1條蠍子尾巴^000000製作一份！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
If you bring these items to me,
with all my pride as a monster
tamer, I will make it for you!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
把這些道具帶給我，我就會以馴獸師的驕傲為你製作！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Ah...!
You must have not decided which Monster you want to raise.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
啊...！
看來你還沒有決定想飼養哪種魔物。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Definitely not a decision to be made carelessly! Your pet monster will accompany you throughout your life. Please take your time and return when you have decided.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
這絕對不是一個可以草率決定的事情！你的寵物魔物將陪伴你一生。請慢慢考慮，想好了再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Munak's grandma]
Oh my...
Have you seen my granddaughter,
young lady? My poor granddaughter
has been missing...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
哎呀...年輕女士，你見過我的孫女嗎？我可憐的孫女失蹤了...

scripts.text:
[Munak's grandma]
Oh my...
Have you seen my granddaughter,
boy? My poor granddaughter
has been missing...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
哎呀...年輕人，你見過我的孫女嗎？我可憐的孫女失蹤了...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
I can't remember exactly when it
was, but when I lived in Payon, I
had a cute granddaughter. She
was really happy when I made her
hair like ^000077Danggie^000000...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
我不記得具體是哪一年了，但我住在斐揚時有個可愛的孫女。每次我給她梳成^000077丹吉^000000髮型，她都高興極了...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
She was alwaying working with the
village chief... She was such a sweet
girl, and always got along with
chief's son...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
她總是和村長一起做事...她是個可愛的女孩，也總和村長的兒子相處得很好...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
But one day our deity became angry
and cursed the chief's son with a
sickness! The village had to offer
my granddaughter to him as a
companion to lift the curse...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
但有一天，神明發怒，讓村長的兒子染上疾病！為了替他解除詛咒，村裡只好把我的孫女送去陪伴他...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
The chief's son regained his
health, but I lost my
granddaughter! I can't look at him
and not think of her, so I tried to
leave my misery behind and came
here to Comodo...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
村長的兒子恢復了健康，我卻失去了孫女！我一看到他就會想起她，於是離開了這份痛苦，來到了克魔島...

scripts.text: Oh come on! Cheer up!
scripts.translation: 哎呀，別這樣！振作起來！

scripts.text: Um, is this diary...?
scripts.translation: 嗯，這是日記...？

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
It seems my granddaughter haunts my
dreams every night. I believe I've
been trying to cheer up for years
now...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
看來孫女每晚都會出現在我的夢裡。這些年來，我一直努力讓自己振作起來...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh god!
It's my granddaughter's diary!
Th-This is her writing! Oh my...!
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
天哪！這是我孫女的日記！這...這是她的筆跡！哎呀...！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Young lady... I'll read this to you if
you give it to me with a Danggie,
please. I no longer have anything
that belonged to her now...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
年輕女士...請把日記和一件丹吉交給我，我就讀給你聽。我現在已經沒有任何屬於她的東西了...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Young man... I'll read this to you if
you give it to me with a Danggie,
please. I no longer have anything
that belonged to her now...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
年輕人...請把日記和一件丹吉交給我，我就讀給你聽。我現在已經沒有任何屬於她的東西了...

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行

scripts.text: Ok, I will.
scripts.translation: 好的，我會的

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh...?
Thank you anyway,
young lady
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
哦...？
還是要謝謝你，年輕女士。

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh...?
Alright, young man.
Thank you anyway.
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
哦...？
好吧，年輕人。
還是謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
It's alright...
I can only hope that the deity is
taking good care of her!
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
沒關係...我只希望神明能好好照顧她！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Goodness!
Thank you,
young lady...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
天哪！謝謝你，年輕女士...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh!
Thank you,
young man~!
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
哦！謝謝你，年輕人~！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Alright...
I'll read this.
Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
好吧...我來讀讀看。讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
It seems that my granddaughter was
treated by the chief like his own
child! There are so many happy
memories in this book!
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
看來村長把我的孫女當作自己的孩子一樣對待！日記裡記錄了許多快樂的回憶！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh, thank you. I now have a good
keepsake of my granddaughter. Thank
you so much! May God-Poing bless
you!
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
哦，謝謝你。我現在有了孫女留下的美好紀念品。真的非常感謝你！願波因之神保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
What? A diary? What's that diary...?
I don't... I can't remember, oh my...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
什麼？日記？那本日記...？我...我不記得了，哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
I really wish I could make her hair
into a ^000077Danggie^000000 again. I really
wish... Oh, oh my granddaughter...
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
我真希望能再給她扎一次^000077丹吉^000000。我真希望...哦，我的孫女...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
My own granddaughter...
Why did she have to leave...?
scripts.translation:
[殭屍女的奶奶]
我的孫女...她為什麼要離開...？
